visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged male chef with a short haircut, wearing a white professional chef uniform with pink sleeve accents, is seen in a medium shot. He looks down with a focused expression while using a wooden spoon to stir content in a pan, though the pan is partially out of frame. The background is a studio kitchen with brick walls and shelves containing kitchenware. Large text identifies him as Chef Qiu. (2) The same chef stands in a brightly lit studio, smiling and gesturing with his hands while speaking directly to the camera. To his left is a black metal shelf stocked with various kitchen items and ingredients. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a plate of braised pork belly and taro. Wooden chopsticks lift a succulent, glistening piece of pork to reveal its texture and layers. (4) A second, younger male chef appears, stirring ingredients in a glass bowl. He is also in a white chef's coat and works within the same blurred kitchen background. (5) This second chef is then shown in the studio, smiling warmly and explaining his dish. (10) A fourth male chef, Mize, is shown in the studio. He has a professional and friendly demeanor. (11) A close-up shows him pouring a dark, rich sauce from a metal ladle into a white bowl containing rice and meat. (12) A close-up of South Asian Curry Rice is shown, with a spoon lifting a piece of chicken. (13) A fifth male chef, Max, appears in the studio, speaking enthusiastically. (14) A close-up shows him pouring Laksa soup from a ladle. (15) A close-up of Singaporean Laksa Seafood Vermicelli is shown, with chopsticks lifting the thin noodles. (16) The final shot shows all five chefs standing together in the studio, smiling at the camera. Below them, images of their five specific dishes are displayed alongside FamilyMart branding and a QR code.
